failure_clusters.does_not_prove: Does not prove that all trades exceeding 30 minutes are unprofitable, as some may eventually reach targets after prolonged consolidation.
evidence: Gross loss of 106.40 R across 122 trades in the long_exposure_ge_30m cluster.
Global review identifies S02 as suffering from severe duration decay.

failure_clusters.does_not_prove: Does not prove that a break-even stop will not prematurely exit trades that experience normal pullbacks before reaching larger targets.
evidence: Gross loss of 129.76 R across 138 trades in the favorable_then_loss_mfe_ge_0_50R cluster.
Average MFE is 1.10R but win rate is only 26.57%, indicating significant round-tripping.
